---
title: "map_total_tests"
author: "Gianni Ardielli"
output: html_document
---

Goal:
Map 
- amount of tests by function
- percentage of "results the same" and "results correct"
Calculate how much tests are implemented for each function and evaluate if the
tests rely on real(results correct) or fake data(results the same).
This helps to show where more tests should be added.

# Setup

```{r setup}

pacman::p_load(dplyr, tibble, stringr, purrr,ggplot2,tidyr)

```






# RR

```{r RR pathways}
files <- base::list.files(
  path = "tests/testthat",
  pattern = "\\.R$",      # only R scripts
  full.names = TRUE       
)

# Function to extract test names from a file
extract_test_names <- function(file_path) {
  
  file_content <- base::readLines(file_path)
  file_content <- file_content[!base::grepl("^\\s*#", file_content)]  # remove comments
  
  # Extract test_that descriptions
  test_names <- base::regmatches(
    file_content,
    base::gregexpr('testthat::test_that\\("\\K[^"]+(?=", \\{)', 
             file_content, 
             perl = TRUE)
  )
  
  tibble::tibble(
    file = base::basename(file_path),
    test_name = base::unlist(test_names)
  )
}

# Read all files
all_tests <- purrr::map_dfr(files, extract_test_names)

# Categorize tests
results_summary <- all_tests |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    category = dplyr::case_when(
      stringr::str_detect(test_name, stringr::regex("results correct", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results correct",
      stringr::str_detect(test_name, stringr::regex("results the same", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results the same",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(category)) |>
  dplyr::count(file, category)

results_summary
```
# Transform

```{r Transform}



results_transformed <- results_summary |>
  dplyr::group_by(file) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_total = base::sum(n),
    n_res_correct = base::sum(n[category == "results correct"]),
    percent_res_correct = base::round(n_res_correct / n_total * 100, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

df_plot <- results_transformed |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    n_incorrect = n_total - n_res_correct
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(file, n_res_correct, n_incorrect) |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(n_res_correct, n_incorrect),
    names_to = "type",
    values_to = "value"
  )

ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = file, y = value, fill = type)) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = base::c(
      "n_res_correct" = "darkgreen",
      "n_incorrect" = "grey"
    ),
    labels = base::c(
      "n_res_correct" = "results correct",
      "n_incorrect" = "results the same"
    ),
    name = ""
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = "Test File",
    y = "Number of Tests",
    title = "Test Results per File"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
base::print(results_transformed)

```




# Single path elements

```{r Single path elements}


test_folder <- "tests/testthat/"

# LOAD all files
files <- base::list.files(test_folder, pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)

# For-loop along single files
for(file in files) {
  base::cat("Processing file:", file, "\n")
  
  file_content <- base::readLines(file)
  file_content <- file_content[!base::grepl("^\\s*#", file_content)]
  
  # extract names
  test_names <- base::regmatches(
    file_content,
    base::gregexpr(
      'testthat::test_that\\("\\K[^"]+(?=", \\{)',
      file_content,
      perl = TRUE
    )
  )
  
  all_tests <- tibble::tibble(test_name = unlist(test_names))
  
  # extract elements of the path
  all_tests_parsed <- all_tests |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      category = dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(test_name, stringr::regex("results correct", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results_correct",
        stringr::str_detect(test_name, stringr::regex("results the same", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ "results_the_same",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      path_elements = stringr::str_extract_all(test_name, "(?<=\\|)[^\\|]+(?=\\|)")
    ) |>
    dplyr::filter(!base::is.na(category))
  
  # cheg if et least two different paths
  valid_paths <- all_tests_parsed |>
    dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(test_name, "results correct|results the same")) |>
    dplyr::pull(path_elements) |>
    purrr::map_chr(~ base::paste(.x, collapse = "|")) |>
    unique()
  
  if(base::length(valid_paths) < 2) {#skip if only one path
    base::cat("Skipping file (not enough valid paths):", file, "\n\n")
    next  
  }
  
  df_wide <- all_tests_parsed |>
    tidyr::unnest_wider(path_elements, names_sep = "_")
  
  df_long <- df_wide |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = tidyr::starts_with("path_elements_"),
      names_to = "level",
      values_to = "element"
    ) |>
    filter(!base::is.na(element))
  
  df_counts <- df_long |>
    dplyr::group_by(level, element, category) |>
    dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  df_counts_wide <- df_counts |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = category,
      values_from = n,
      values_fill = 0
    )
  
  # add col if necessary 
if(!"results_correct" %in% base::unique(df_counts$category)) {
  df_counts_wide$results_correct <- 0
}

if(!"results_the_same" %in% base::unique(df_counts$category)) {
  df_counts_wide$results_the_same <- 0
}
  
  df_plot <- df_counts_wide |>
    dplyr::select(level, element, results_correct, results_the_same) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = c(results_correct, results_the_same),
      names_to = "type",
      values_to = "value"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(type = base::factor(type, levels = base::c("results_the_same", "results_correct")))

  p <- ggplot2::ggplot(df_plot, ggplot2::aes(x = element, y = value, fill = type)) +
    ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "results_correct" = "darkgreen",
        "results_the_same" = "grey"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "results_correct" = "results correct",
        "results_the_same" = "results the same"
      ),
      name = ""
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = "Element",
      y = "Number of Tests",
      title = base::basename(file)
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
  
  base::print(p)  
  base::Sys.sleep(0.5)  # short pause to enable plot generation
  
}

```
